source: Countries, mapped to the US region with the largest percentage of its immigrants and expatriates among the total population.
claim: For each of the 154 countries, the data identify the single US PUMA with the largest percentage of that country's foreign-born population, and the printed series lists the top PUMA country by country.

NYC-Brooklyn Community District 13--Brighton Beach & Coney Island is the top PUMA for four countries (Azerbaijan, Byelorussia, Republic of Georgia and Ukraine), and NYC-Brooklyn Community District 17--East Flatbush, Farragut & Rugby is the top PUMA for another four (Barbados, Grenada, St. Vincent and Trinidad and Tobago).
